title: Boss: the fish counter
hints: Four arms catch 50 fish each, so the count should be 200. Run it in both worlds: it isn't.
Between `seen = fish` and `fish = seen + 1` another arm can sneak in and its fish get lost. Without the GIL (world 2) the arms really run at the same time, so even more get lost.
Make the two lines one step nobody can break into: `lock = threading.Lock()` and put them inside `with lock:`.

sk.title: Boss: počítadlo rýb
hints: Štyri chápadlá chytia po 50 rýb, takže počet má byť 200. Spusti to v oboch svetoch: nie je.
Medzi `seen = fish` a `fish = seen + 1` sa môže vkradnúť iné chápadlo a jeho ryby sa stratia. Bez GIL (svet 2) bežia chápadlá naozaj naraz, takže sa ich stratí ešte viac.
Sprav z tých dvoch riadkov jeden krok, do ktorého nikto nevstúpi: `lock = threading.Lock()` a daj ich do `with lock:`.
